slides.subtitle: Your network is your unfair edge

bullets: Most roles get filled before they're posted
Join Discord and Slack communities in your niche
Comment, not just lurk - people remember names

caption: Solo job hunting in cyber is the slow road. Most roles fill before they're posted - through people who already know someone. Start showing up where your people are. #cybersecurity #cybersecuritycareers #networking #community #cypherjobs
